decisions.proposal: Standard store-supported native purchase route unless a qualified alternative/access-only route is explicitly selected and verified for the actual distribution/storefront/enrollment.

decisions.topic: Exact store products, plan/cycle/seat variants and buyer/workspace mapping
decisions.proposal: Versioned server-approved mapping; immutable account/workspace purchase intent; no client-defined price or arbitrary store quantity.
Use actual selected store products and localized checkout values; web rate/FX and legacy finance rounding are not native purchase authority. No new price adopted here.
Explicit policy retains one rightful purchaser/source binding and valid workspace access; no email-based purchase merge.
Preserve accepted manual Family/Business algorithms; define provider-product changes and future capacity without overbooking.

decisions.topic: Optional web gateway and eligible alternative-billing programs
decisions.proposal: Select only after operator/merchant/channel/program facts are verified; no Paynow/Stripe integration or external native link is implied.
Separate provider-verified store state from privileged manual grants; project entitlements under approved precedence rather than blind last-writer overwrite.
Keep secrets private/server-only; accepted isolated sandbox transactions and recovery precede real charging or release.
